message: In our busy lives, it’s easy to forget the simple joys of being prepared. Rediscovering low-tech fun can be a great way to bond with family while ensuring we’re ready for anything. 🌟 This resource from the Red Cross reminds us of the essentials we might overlook. By gathering supplies together, we not only create a safety net but also spark creativity and teamwork. What’s your favorite tip for making preparedness a fun family activity?
